document: Sales Order Header: Represents the finalized commercial sales order generated after quotation approval or direct order creation. It captures customer identity, quotation linkage, organizational context, currency and pricing terms, sales ownership, and commercial controls. This table acts as the parent transactional record for all sales order line items and is the foundation for dispatch, invoicing, and revenue reporting.

join_guidance.description: Use this join to retrieve item-level sales information such as quantities, unit prices, discounts, taxes, and delivery dates. This join is mandatory for order value calculations, product-wise sales analysis, fulfillment tracking, and margin reporting.

Use this join to trace the sales order back to its originating quotation for conversion analysis, approval timelines, negotiated pricing, and quotation validity. Left join is required because not all sales orders originate from quotations.

Use this join to enrich sales orders with lead or customer context such as industry, lead source, decision-maker, and conversion history. This join supports pipeline-to-revenue and customer lifecycle analysis.

document: Sales Order Details: Stores item-wise line information for each sales order including product, quantity, pricing, discounts, tax structure, delivery commitments, and fulfillment attributes. Each record represents a single sellable line item linked to a sales order header.

join_guidance.description: Mandatory join to obtain customer, order-level attributes, currency, and commercial context for each line item.
Use this join to track dispatched quantities, invoiced values, packaging, and logistics execution against each sales order line. Left join ensures visibility of undelivered or pending items.

document: Quotation Header: Represents commercial quotations issued to customers during the pre-sales stage. It includes pricing terms, approval workflow, validity, export and logistics conditions, and negotiated values. This table acts as the source document for many sales orders.

join_guidance.description: Use this join to analyze quotation-to-order conversion rates, approval efficiency, revenue realization, and dropped or expired quotations.
Use this join to connect quotations to originating leads or enquiries for pipeline effectiveness, source attribution, and pre-sales performance analysis.

document: Lead Details: Captures prospect and customer enquiry information including contact details, industry, interest areas, lead source, sales ownership, and conversion status. This table represents the earliest stage of the sales lifecycle and feeds into quotations and orders.

join_guidance.description: Use this join to measure lead-to-quotation conversion, sales responsiveness, and pre-sales effectiveness.
Use this join to analyze full funnel performance from lead generation to revenue realization.

document: Dispatch Details: Records logistics and fulfillment execution for sales order lines, including dispatched quantities, packaging, freight, taxes, billing references, and inventory organization. This table bridges sales orders with invoicing and physical delivery.

join_guidance.description: Mandatory join to connect dispatch execution with ordered items for fulfillment tracking, billing validation, and logistics analysis.
Use this join to roll up dispatch and invoicing metrics at the sales order and customer level.
